E2903

Performance budget `{name}` is not valid

What

Performance budget `{name}` is not valid

Why

One grammar rule, typed value, unit, direction, comparison, or applicability constraint is invalid.

Fix

use the one legal typed budget form named by the diagnostic.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E2903: tests/ui/perf_budget_unknown_role_field.stderr.

Error [E2903]: performance budget role `release` is not valid
  --> tests/ui/perf_budget_unknown_role_field.jet:2:5
    |
  2 |     limits: []
    |     ^^^^^^
 Why: a performance role contains one `budgets` list and at most one `compile_workloads` map
 Fix: write `budgets: [Budget{ ... }]` and, for edit probes, `compile_workloads: { ... }`
